meta.description: Massage and advanced aesthetics studio at Rambla de l'Exposició, 103, Vilanova i la Geltrú. Deep tissue massage, facial and body treatments, laser and skincare. Book by WhatsApp.

hero.eyebrow: Rambla de l'Exposició, 103 · Vilanova i la Geltrú
hero.title: A massage that gives you back your neck — and your back
hero.subtitle: Judit works with her hands and with time: she listens first, then decides how to treat the area that is bothering you. No rushing, and nothing prescribed you do not need.
hero.hint: She answers herself. If you describe what is going on, she will tell you which treatment fits before you settle on a day and time.
hero.point1: She listens before starting: the session adapts to how you arrive that day.
hero.point2: Deep tissue work, plus treatment for knots and tension.
hero.point3: Advanced aesthetics: laser, facial care and the skincare she uses herself.
hero.photoAlt: Inside Judit Quiromasaje's massage and aesthetics studio in Vilanova i la Geltrú

treat.title: What can be treated
treat.lead: Three lines of work that often combine in a single visit. There is no price list pasted up here: each session is agreed on what you need and how long it will take, and you hear that before anything begins.

massage.title: Massage
massage.lead: The heart of the studio, and the reason most people come here for the first time.

items.name: Deep tissue massage
items.text: Firm, sustained pressure on muscles that have been pulling for weeks. It is the treatment that comes up most in the reviews: people who arrive with a locked neck and leave without the knot.

items.name: Knots and tension
items.text: For specific points — the neck, the shoulder blade, the lower back — that stretching at home does not shift. The area is worked along with what surrounds it, so the knot does not come straight back.

items.name: Full body massage
items.text: A complete session when what you need is to properly switch off. It is also the one most often given as a present, and the studio keeps gift cards.

aesthetics.title: Advanced aesthetics
aesthetics.lead: Devices and treatment skincare, always after the skin has been assessed first.

items.name: Laser hair removal
items.text: One of the services the studio is recommended for most: clients who had tried other places and who noticed the difference here after years of sessions elsewhere.

items.name: Facial care
items.text: Cleansing, hydration and treatment based on how your skin is that day, not on a fixed protocol. You leave with calmer skin and with instructions for home.

items.name: Targeted treatments
items.text: One-off advanced aesthetics work decided in the room, once it is clear what the skin needs and what it does not.

body.title: Body and products
body.lead: What you can take home, and the body work that goes beyond massage.

items.name: Body scrub
items.text: Skin that needs renewing, especially before summer or after a long winter. It shows immediately and prepares the skin for the rest of the treatment.

items.name: Studio skincare
items.text: Aloe gel, cream deodorant and a yoghurt scrub: products she uses and recommends because she has tried them, not because there is something to sell.

items.name: Gift cards
items.text: For giving a session without having to choose the treatment yourself: whoever receives it decides what they want when they call. It is one of the details the reviews mention most.

treat.note: If you are not sure which treatment is yours, say so in the message: four lines about what is going on is enough to point you in the right direction.

first.title: How the first time works
first.lead: You do not need to know the name of the treatment or how many sessions you need. That gets decided there, talking.
first.body: The studio is small and visits are one at a time: there is no full waiting room, and nobody hurrying you because the next session is due. If you are coming about a specific problem, say how long you have had it and what you have already tried; if you are coming for aesthetics, say what has worked and what has not elsewhere.
first.step1Text: On WhatsApp, with what is going on and when suits you. No form to fill in and no call first.
first.step2Text: She tells you which treatment fits, how long it needs and what it will cost, before anything is booked.
first.step3Title: You come with time to spare
first.step3Text: Arrive a few minutes early so there is room to talk. If you have medical reports or creams you use, bring them.
first.step4Text: After the session you know how you are, what to do at home, and — if you need to come back — when it makes sense to.
first.practical2: Sessions can be given as gift cards.

about.title: One professional, one room, and a lot of people who come back
about.lead: Judit Quiromasaje is a massage and advanced aesthetics studio on Rambla de l'Exposició. There is a single practitioner behind it, and that explains how everything works.
about.body1: People describe it the same way every time: she listens first, then works. The session does not follow a protocol but follows how you arrive that day, which is why the same hands suit a locked neck and skin that needs a specific treatment.
about.body2: The reputation comes from word of mouth. More than a hundred and sixty reviews and an average of five out of five are not built with advertising: they happen when people who leave feeling better tell the people around them.
about.statRating: on Google, with no review below it
about.pull: “Since I met her, I don't go anywhere else.”

reviews.title: What the people who have been say
reviews.lead: Five five-star reviews, chosen from the more than one hundred and sixty on Google. We have translated them into English and trimmed each one to the part about the treatment.

t1.text: I went in with a lot of neck pain and the experience was very good from the first moment. She listened, explained what she would do, and the treatment worked: I noticed the improvement straight away and over the following days the pain dropped a lot.
t1.author: Marc Sanchez Margalef

t2.text: I walked in with a lot of muscle tension and left feeling like new. Excellent service and a lovely manner. I will definitely be back.
t2.author: Gaston Manero

t3.text: Treatments with Judit are a genuinely good experience: she personalises them and adapts them to what you need, honestly. The laser is the best result I have had after years of trying places. And the gift card made the person who received it very happy.
t3.author: Jennifer

t4.text: Excellent massage therapist. I had a terrible knot in my neck and back and she got rid of it. Excellent hands, I will be back.
t4.author: Katty Urriola

t5.text: Excellent service. I had a deep tissue massage and from the first minute Judit put all her effort into making me feel better. Thoroughly recommended.
t5.author: Natalia Sanmamed

contact.title: Book by WhatsApp
contact.lead: The mobile is the fastest route: she answers herself and a day and time usually gets settled in a couple of messages. If you would rather talk, call the same number.
contact.whatsappNote: If you write, it helps to say in one line what you need — massage, laser, facial — and which days suit you.
contact.phoneNote: Calls and WhatsApp on the same number.
